ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approx. 95% of the visible surface area, with sparse, high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing approx. 5% of the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Sparse white circular punctate marks distributed across both lobes. A prominent high-contrast annulus (ring-shaped cluster) is located in the medial region of the left lobe. Multiple vertical and diagonal high-intensity linear streaks are mapped across the central and right lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central lobe junction with a narrow vertex angle and symmetrical depth relative to the inner lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire horizontal boundary. The left distal tip exhibits extreme jaggedness with significant tissue-level variations (peaks and valleys) compared to the more rhythmic serration of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-upward curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular white pixel clusters (punctate scars) scattered across both lobes. One distinctive hollow-centered circular ring is visible on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel linear streaks of high-intensity pixels. Includes one prominent vertical mark on the right lobe and several finer, unaligned scratches on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular morphology on the far-left trailing edge tip, characterized by deep, non-uniform tissue loss or jagged fracturing.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular 'o-ring' white scar on the left lobe and a prominent, nearly vertical white linear streak on the right lobe.
